Author: SHIGYL
Name: Briosis
Description: A community GPose posing toolkit based on Brio, with expanded facial-expression controls, facial presets, and advanced tongue posing tools adapted from and inspired by Ktisis.
Punchline: Brio-based GPose tools with advanced facial and tongue posing.
Changelog: Added Brio/Briosis coexistence protection for GPose, IPC, commands, and the optional Web API.
